At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness…
One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two…

parallels.note: You are witnesses of these things.

translations.web: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
translations.bsb: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
translations.kjv: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall ➔ every word be established.
translations.asv: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every word established.
